title: Agentic Data Sampling Framework for Multilingual ASR via Linguistic-Aware Error-Driven Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.36538v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) has achieved rapid progress with large-scale pretrained models and multilingual speech corpora. Previous studies have proved the pivotal role of data sampling in multilingual ASR performance. However, existing sampling strategies largely rely on time-consuming manual, heuristic-based designs. To address this, we propose a linguistic-aware agentic data sampling framework that introduces a data sampling LLM agent into the multilingual ASR training loop. The agent is driven by a linguistically grounded rubric that analyzes ASR errors from phonological, morphological, and syntactic perspectives, and uses the resulting feedback together with training statistics, budget constraints, and algorithm profiles to select domain-level, sample-level, and token-level sampling strategies. translated_title: 基于语言学感知错误驱动优化的多语言自动语音识别（ASR）智能体数据采样框架
translated_abstract: 多语言自动语音识别（ASR）在大规模预训练模型和多语言语音语料库的推动下取得了快速进展。以往研究已经证明了数据采样在多语言ASR性能中的关键作用。然而，现有的采样策略在很大程度上依赖于耗时的人工和基于启发式规则的设计。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种语言学感知的智能体数据采样框架，将数据采样大语言模型（LLM）智能体引入多语言ASR的训练循环中。该智能体由基于语言学的评价准则驱动，从音系学、形态学和句法学的角度分析ASR错误，并利用由此产生的反馈，结合训练统计数据、预算约束和算法配置，来选择域级、样本级和词元级的采样策略。这种设计将评估结果转化为自适应的数据选择决策，而不是将WER/CER仅仅视为最终终点指标
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将LLM智能体引入多语言ASR训练循环的智能体数据采样框架，通过从音系、形态和句法等语言学角度分析识别错误，自适应地选择不同层级的数据采样策略以优化模型训练。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an agentic data sampling framework that introduces an LLM agent into the multilingual ASR training loop, which adaptively selects data sampling strategies by analyzing recognition errors from linguistic perspectives including phonology, morphology, and syntax.
